set_aside.subject: edge-delivery taxonomy
set_aside.text: “EDGE_DELIVERY_RULES” is added to `data_provider`, whose correspondence tables are “keyed by the enumeration, total over its members, whose cells name members”, but `models` owns only “the State 1 records M01–M28 as plain typed data, with their closed status and class enumerations”; no module is assigned ownership of the new `enabled` / `disabled` / `undecided` delivery-state set or of the guard-condition categories needed to key this table.
set_aside.question: Which module owns the edge-delivery-state and guard-condition taxonomies, and are they `models` enumerations usable by `data_provider` and `run_graph`?
options: Add the delivery and guard-condition taxonomies to `models` and type `EDGE_DELIVERY_RULES` with them
Make the taxonomies private to `data_provider` and expose a typed lookup capability
Make the taxonomies private to `run_graph` and remove the shared table
set_aside.default_guess: Add model enumerations for delivery state and normalized guard condition, then make `EDGE_DELIVERY_RULES` a total typed table over them.

set_aside.subject: ownership split for EDGE_DELIVERY_RULES
set_aside.text: `run_graph` owns “whether each edge is enabled, disabled or not yet decided” and “guard evaluation”, while it now knows `data_provider` for “conclusion and edge-delivery tables”; the text never states what `EDGE_DELIVERY_RULES` contains or which part of A13 rule 9 remains computation owned by `run_graph`.
set_aside.question: Does `run_graph` derive source success and guard match and merely look up the delivery result, or does `EDGE_DELIVERY_RULES` itself encode source-status normalization, guard evaluation, and the complete delivery decision?
options: `run_graph` computes normalized source and guard conditions, then uses a total result table
The table maps raw execution/conclusion states and guard facts to delivery states
`run_graph` owns the whole decision and the added table is only test/reference data
set_aside.default_guess: Have `run_graph` compute a normalized source-success condition and guard outcome, then use a total `data_provider` lookup for the delivery state.
